runtime: native Apple Silicon, PyTorch MPS / CPU decode; existing Python3.12 environments

sources.usage: local development and evaluation; publication not authorized

sync.method: 7-window shared-audio energy correlation; visual verification pending
sync.sound_travel_note: Acoustic delay depends on contact position; rolling shutter and exposure are unverified.
sync.drift_note: No stable drift established; unity clock rate retained. Manual offset supported.

side.decode: original 4K source decoded and resized to 1280×720 CPU
side.note: Heuristic coverage is not recall. Sequential paired FPS = reciprocal sum of measured per-view seconds/frame.

development_grayscale.method: Source centers estimated visually at 960×540 without detector overlays. Ambiguous/occluded/cropped ball = unassessable, not negative.
development_grayscale.split: Development slice 7.4–9.75 s; not held-out, no overall footage accuracy claim.

side.note: No absent-frame annotations; false-positive rate on absent frames is not established.

diagonal.note: No absent-frame annotations; false-positive rate on absent frames is not established.

held_out_grayscale.split: Held-out fixed-time slices 40–41.1 and 87–88.1 seconds, not used to change tracker settings. Mostly occlusion/held-ball interval; not an active-rally benchmark.

source_pose_report.model: MediaPipe Pose Landmarker Full float16 v1
source_pose_report.roi_identity: Green/left=0, Blue/right=1; positional prior, not reidentification
notes: Hip-relative model world coordinates are inferred, not measured table coordinates.
No open-palm, paddle orientation, release or contact evidence is inferred from this body model.
Only observed sampled poses are exported. Missing people remain missing.

calibration.validation: Four manually selected coplanar corners at source 6s; no independent height/intrinsics ground truth

camera_stabilization.method: ORB table-region descriptors + independent current-to-reference RANSAC
camera_stabilization.scope: illustrative avatar image stabilization only; not validated metric calibration

presentation_smoothing.method: symmetric Savitzky-Golay filtering + constant-length limb retargeting
presentation_smoothing.scope: render_joints only; raw joints and ball measurements unchanged
presentation_smoothing.root_prior: Display only: end-position lane x +/-[1.35,3.5]m, unobserved y=0, 5-sample median root filter
presentation_smoothing.accuracy: Smoothing diagnostics are not motion-capture accuracy or metric evidence

hands.status: pixel wrist-crop observations only; metric release/open-palm evidence unvalidated

probes.model: MediaPipe Hand Landmarker Full float16 v1
notes: Coverage is not hand/palm or release accuracy; overlapping wrist crops may detect the same hand.
Native-pixel crops preserve the crop-to-source transform; pose hints are sampled and may be stale.
Hand skeletons and handedness do not prove open stationary palm, ball release, or metric height.
No hand/paddle data is fed into automatic real-footage serve decisions without validation.

pose.paddle: Wrist-attached illustration only; face orientation and contact not measured
pose.ball_3d: Unavailable: moving cameras lack validated time-varying metric calibration and sync
notes: Source 2D landmark coordinates and model world outputs are retained unchanged in poses.json.
Scene root placement, occluded-leg prior, body shape and paddle are illustrative estimates.
Image stabilization is for presentation, and may fail under occlusion or large camera motion.
render_joints are separately smoothed; raw joints and source time are unchanged by smoothing.
No avatar quantity is used as referee measurement evidence.

checks.browser: pairedplayback, slowmotion/challenge, original4Kcrop, illustrative avatars, manualresolution, synthetic scoreonce

limitation: Manual pixel labels are approximate single-reviewer annotations. No absent-ball negatives establish false-positive rate. Geometry unit tests are synthetic, never real-world accuracy evidence.
